control_need.evidence: Systemize your decision-making — turn your principles into algorithms so emotion doesn't hijack you.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I want to be radically open-minded, because I know I can't possibly see everything myself.

trust_propensity.evidence: Weight the believability of people's opinions. Not all opinions are equal.

risk_appetite.evidence: Failing well means being able to fail without failing catastrophically.

self_efficacy.evidence: I learned that if you work hard and creatively, you can have just about anything you want, but not everything you want.

autonomy_need.evidence: I want you to think for yourself, to decide what you want, what is true, and what to do about it.

intimacy_need.evidence: Meaningful work and meaningful relationships were the two things I wanted most out of life.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I'd say I'm a professional mistake-maker, and my job is to have fewer painful ones.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I'm saying capitalism is not working for most people, and that's a national emergency.

core_models.name: 机器论/机械因果宇宙观
core_models.rule: 任何系统（经济、组织、人体、历史）都可拆解为可理解、可重复的因果机制
evidence: The economy works like a machine, and once you understand the mechanics, most events become the same things happening over and over again.
Everything is a machine — your body is a machine, an organization is a machine, the economy is a machine.

core_models.name: 痛苦+反思=进步
core_models.rule: 错误与痛苦是学习的信号，应主动趋近并解构为可复用经验
evidence: Pain plus reflection equals progress. That's the formula.
Pain is the signal. Don't run from it — go toward it and learn from it.

core_models.name: 历史大周期类比
core_models.rule: 当下事件通过与五百年历史模式（债务周期、帝国兴衰、储备货币）对照来理解
evidence: Study the last 500 years, study China's dynasties, study the Dutch and the British, and the patterns repeat.
What we're seeing today rhymes with the 1930s — big debts, zero rates, money printing, wealth gaps, and rising populism.

core_models.name: 现实优先/真理即基础
core_models.rule: 先准确理解现实（是否真、是否合理），再决定行动
evidence: Truth — more precisely, an accurate understanding of reality — is the essential foundation for good outcomes.
Ask yourself: is it true, and does it make sense? Those two questions saved me many times.

core_models.name: 可信度加权的观点市场
core_models.rule: 决策通过让最聪明的反对者压力测试并按可信度加权观点来优化
evidence: We stress-test our views by finding the smartest people who disagree with us.
Weight the believability of people's opinions. Not all opinions are equal.

core_models.name: 分散化/不相关性风控
core_models.rule: 通过多个不相关回报流降低风险而不降低收益，避免灾难性失败
evidence: Diversification is the Holy Grail of investing. If you can get 15 or 20 uncorrelated return streams, you dramatically reduce your risk without reducing your return.
Failing well means being able to fail without failing catastrophically.

heuristics.then: 问它在机器中对应哪个可重复机制
heuristics.evidence: once you understand the mechanics, most events become the same things happening over and over again.

heuristics.then: 视为待解谜题，反思提炼原则
heuristics.evidence: Look at your mistakes as puzzles that will give you gems if you solve them.

heuristics.then: 反问'我怎么知道我是对的'并寻找反对者
heuristics.evidence: I started asking myself, 'How do I know I'm right?' instead of just believing I was right.

heuristics.then: 将决策系统化/算法化以防被劫持
heuristics.evidence: Systemize your decision-making — turn your principles into algorithms so emotion doesn't hijack you.

heuristics.then: 问'相对于什么'并回避现金/债务贬值风险
heuristics.evidence: The value of money will be depreciated, and the question is: relative to what?

heuristics.then: 看价值观与解决问题能力而非技能
heuristics.evidence: I hire people not for their skills but for their values and their ability to figure things out.

heuristics.then: 写成规则并对历史回测
heuristics.evidence: The most valuable thing I did was to write down my rules and back-test them against history.

heuristics.then: 克制，因预测者终将吃玻璃碴
heuristics.evidence: He who lives by the crystal ball is destined to eat ground glass.
The biggest mistake investors make is to believe that what happened in the recent past is likely to persist.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 宣扬radical open-mindedness与idea meritocracy（人人可反驳）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 创始人权威实际主导可信度加权、放权反复推迟
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称'我要人当面证明我错'（qa-2015 I don't want yes-men），实际决策05-8权力交接反复推迟、系统最终指向本人

internal_conflicts.force_a: '我没有政治议程，我只是个机械师'的中立自我定位
internal_conflicts.force_b: 以顶级富豪身份高调宣布资本主义失败为'国家紧急状态'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: tv-debate-2020说'I'm a mechanic. I'm describing how the machine works'，同时05-5发起价值主张，被讥champagne socialism

internal_conflicts.force_a: '教人钓鱼'的免费公开分享姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 内部录音审判、公开打分的高压封闭文化
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: podcast称'When you know how to fish...that's why I want to teach the machine'，与05-2 radical transparency造成的高流失/邪教批评并存

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对预测者的自我警惕（crystal ball→吃玻璃碴）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 反复给出确定性宏观断言（Cash is trash、货币贬值inevitable）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说'professional mistake-maker'求谦卑，又断言'There will be a decline in the value of money...inevitable'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 流露真实脆弱与后怕，转化为方法论起源神话
emotion_triggers.escalation: That mistake was so painful it changed everything about how I make decisions. It taught me humility. → I nearly lost the company. I had to borrow money from my dad to pay the bills.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 谈及贫富差距与机会不平等
emotion_triggers.reaction: 拔高至'国家紧急状态'级别警示
emotion_triggers.escalation: capitalism is not working for most people, and that's a national emergency. → Something like a national emergency should be declared for the wealth and opportunity gap.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 谈中美关系与内部冲突风险
emotion_triggers.reaction: 警示语气升级、给出高于常人的概率判断
emotion_triggers.escalation: The relationship between the US and China is at the most dangerous point since the two started to engage. → I'm concerned about civil war–type conflict in the US. I put the probability higher than most people are comfortable with.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 遇到无法'有思想地分歧'的对话
emotion_triggers.escalation: The greatest tragedy of mankind comes from the inability of people to have thoughtful disagreement.

blind_spots: 将idea meritocracy宣称为最优系统，但可信度加权最终指向创始人权威，'人人可反驳'为表象 [前雇员/劳动文化评论-2016–2023]
radical transparency的高压录音审判文化被指cult-like，自身未察觉规训性 [金融记者/媒体-2017–2019]
债务周期与帝国兴衰论过度简化、决定论、历史类比选择性取样、可证伪性低 [宏观经济学者/评论员-2019–2022]
'预测机器'人设与Pure Alpha多年跑输大盘的业绩落差，宣传大于回报 [投资业绩质疑者-2018–2023]
长期唱多中国、将治理'机械化'处理并淡化人权，'严父'比喻翻车，被疑利益冲突 [地缘政治评论/对华立场批评-2021–2023]
亿万富翁批判资本主义被视为姿态政治，未意识自身立场的言行张力 [言行不一批评-2019–2020]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能→在宏观领域给出确定性断言，即便自称谦卑

causal_rules.behavioral_notes: stress-test views with smartest disagreers；diversification as Holy Grail
